sdk_implementation_progress.scope: First file-lifecycle export: project_state reads the last opened/saved path and the dirty comparison; save_project stages one atomic save that the Controller performs after the command commits through the existing file save path, reporting a failure as a warning while the document stays dirty. No document open/create/replace from a command.
l3_open: write-failure recovery through the plugin path
project load validation and document reload
sdk_implementation_progress.limits: A plugin cannot choose a save destination or replace the document.

sdk_implementation_progress.scope: Save As request: the plugin asks the host to start its own Save As flow after the command commits; the user chooses the destination and the host performs the atomic save. save and save-as cannot be combined, a busy/failed file operation is a warning, and the plugin never handles a path.
l3_open: write-failure recovery through the plugin path
sdk_implementation_progress.limits: The destination is chosen in the host dialog; the plugin cannot set a path.

sdk_export_plan_policy.rule: Chỉ bề mặt plugin cần (dữ liệu/sự kiện/hành động) mới vào SDK v1; kernel hình học, UI và adapter host nội bộ không vào SDK.
